Description:
Add a unique piece of history to your space with this assortment of vintage teal glass insulators, once used to support overhead power lines. Each insulator in this set showcases distinct shapes, textures, and slightly different shades of teal and green, creating a captivating collection for display. Visible wear and patina reflect their authentic utility and age, enhancing their nostalgic character and appeal. This historical detail adds an extra layer of interest, making the set especially attractive for collectors and history enthusiasts. Ideal for use as decorative accents on shelves, mantels, or desks, these insulators offer a charming way to incorporate industrial heritage into your home or office decor. This item is in used vintage condition and displays signs of wear consistent with age and previous use

description:
Missouri Meerschaum / Hirschl & Bendheim
Corn Cob Pipe Wood Display Plaque
Hardwood, Brass, Corn Cob, Approximately 7.25 x 5 Inches
Vintage tobacciana display plaque celebrating Washington, Missouri's historic legacy as the corn cob pipe capital of the world. The finished dark wood mount features an engraved brass plaque titled "An American Heritage - the original Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Pipe," paired with an authentic corn cob pipe held securely by a metal spring clip. The pipe's bowl retains its original green Hirschl & Bendheim factory label on the underside, representing one of Missouri Meerschaum's most storied historical contemporaries.
Beveled dark-stained wood display plaque with black metal spring retaining clip
Engraved brass nameplate featuring the official Missouri Meerschaum company seal
Corn cob pipe featuring a textured shank, metal ferrule, and amber-colored bit
Original green paper label on pipe base marked Hirschl & Bendheim, Washington, Missouri
Plaque measures approximately 7.25 inches wide by 5 inches tall
Condition:
Wood plaque is structurally sound with light edge wear and minor finish scuffs. Brass plate is securely attached with light surface patina. Pipe shows bowl interior darkening and charring consistent with prior use. Exterior cob bowl and amber stem show light handling wear. Underside factory sticker is intact and legible.

description:
Mineral Specimen Lot - 8 Pieces
Agate, Petrified Wood, Calcite & Quartz Geodes
Natural Mineral Collection
A diverse 8-piece collection of natural mineral and geological display specimens featuring various formations, textures, and crystal structures. The assemblage includes polished cut display stones alongside hollow crystalline geode nodules, highlighting classic lapidary and natural rough presentations.
Items Included:
Polished Agate Half: Cut and face-polished specimen displaying concentric fortification banding in caramel and cream with a crystalline quartz core
Petrified Wood Block: Substantial cut specimen exhibiting rich reddish-brown, yellow, and amber banded grain patterns with raw textured backing
Calcite Cleavage Rhomb Specimen: Translucent block featuring prominent natural rhombohedral cleavage planes and matrix remnants
Quartz Geode Halves (5 pieces): Hollow natural geodes featuring interiors lined with sparkling crystalline quartz druzy cavities
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in sound structural condition. Polished faces on the agate and petrified wood show smooth finishes with minor handling contact. Rough matrix surfaces, natural fissures, crystal cavity inclusions, and cleavage breaks are inherent to the natural stone formation.

description:
Carved Briar Tobacco Pipe
Bent Smoking Pipe With Red Swirl Stem
Briar Wood & Acrylic, Approximately 5 Inches
This vintage estate tobacco smoking pipe features a carved briar bowl in a rounded bent apple profile with a rich reddish-brown finish. Fitted with a silver-tone metal shank band and a curved mouthpiece in marbled red acrylic, it exemplifies mid-to-late 20th century pipe craftsmanship. Carved briar pipes are valued by enthusiasts for their tactile grip and heat dissipation.
Hand-carved scroll and channel texture across the rounded briar bowl
Bent ruby red swirl acrylic stem with silver-tone metal accent band
Stamped numbers 048 and 18 on shank near the band
Measures approximately 5 inches in overall length with a 1.9-inch bowl height
Condition:
Previously smoked estate condition. Bowl shows normal carbon cake and rim char from use. Exterior briar carving remains intact with minor surface handling wear. Stem is secure with minor tooth chatter near the lip. Metal collar is firmly seated.

description:
Title
: Crystal Collection Geode Amethyst Agate Lot 3 Pieces 6" x 4" Inches Largest
Color
: Blue, Purple, White, Gray
Department
: Collectible Lots > Rocks/Artifacts Lot
Category
: Collectibles & Art
Description
: Elevate your space or collection with this striking lot of three natural stone display pieces, each selected for their unique beauty and appeal. Included are a blue-rimmed quartz geode with a crystalline cave, a vibrant purple amethyst cluster with yellowish base, and a large, polished gray quartz standing specimen featuring intricate banded patterns. Each piece boasts distinct mineral textures, vibrant color bands, and naturally polished surfaces visible from all angles, offering an engaging visual experience. Perfect for display in a home, office, or as educational decor, these stones are sure to draw interest for their natural artistry and one-of-a-kind attributes. Each crystal and geode is left in its raw, authentic form, with polished facets where applicable, showing unique formations and details. All stones display visible natural variations and minor imperfections as shown, but are free from major cracks or breaks. See images for exact condition and features of each individual piece.

description:
Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box
This large rock and mineral collection bundle includes the Good and Beautiful branded educational specimen box with 9 labeled compartments featuring igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, and mineral samples such as mica, quartz, and pyrite. Also included is a French-labeled display case with 24 compartments containing various tumbled and raw stones like Microcline, Labradorite, Cornaline, Jaspe, Amazonite, Rhodonite, Calcite, Dolomie, Gabbro, and Apatite in a bamboo-framed glass-covered box. Additionally, there is a large loose assortment of approximately 40+ raw and polished stones and minerals, including lava rock, amethyst cluster, turquoise-colored stone, tiger's eye, petrified wood, onyx/calcite slab, rutilated quartz, and various jaspers and agates. Items show typical used and handled condition consistent with an educational or hobbyist rock collection. Specimens vary in size from small chips to palm-sized pieces. This collection is suitable for geology enthusiasts, collectors, or educational purposes.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

Attached link chain with matching circular domed filigree cap / cover

Carved bowl shows interior residue, surface dust, and wear within carved recesses. Chain, decorative cap, and wire rest remain attached. No maker marks or metal purity hallmarks detected.

How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.
Collections

Many pieces have unspecified condition issues. Please view provided photographs to determine general contents. No part of such groupings may be returned for any reason.

shipping.policy:
Shipping Timeframe:
Orders are packed and shipped in the order that payment is received, Monday through Friday. We typically have orders shipped within 7 business days. We are not open on the weekends or during some major holidays.
Shipping & Handling Charges:
All items will ship via FedEx services. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using dimensional weight to and from both parties' zip codes. Handling charges are not only to cover a full-time shipping department but also to cover boxes, bubble wrap, packing paper, high grade tape, printers, authentication charges, etc.
PO Boxes &
APO/FPO/DPO Addresses:
We do not ship to PO Boxes. This includes APO/FPO/DPO addresses as well. Address used at checkout must be a physical street address. No exceptions, we are unfortunately unable to be flexible on this policy.
If you ignore this, we will attempt to reach out to you once, then cancel your order if no response after 48 hours.
Converting local pickup items to shipping:
We list items as local pickup for a reason and will typically refuse requests to convert items to shipping. If you see other locations shipping an item we have set for local pickup, this is irrelevant and does not mean we are required to do so as well, but you are more than welcome to send us a ticket and discuss it with us.
Third Party Shippers:
We do not partner with any companies or parties that will arrange shipping for local pickup items. If you chose to go this route, do so at your own risk. Once your item has been picked up and signed for, we will not be willing to provide a refund or accept a return for shipping issues or damages due to transportation.
We currently only ship domestically.

AS-IS

Items returned to us will not be shipped back to you

If a package is returned to us due to wrong address given or unable to deliver due to signature not being provided, we will be refunding your order minus the shipping cost.

We describe items to the best of our abilities, but
we are not experts in any field.

unless otherwise started.

description:
Natural Amethyst Quartz Crystal Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished Edge Geode Slab & Cylindrical Core Specimen
Natural Mineral, 2.38 lbs Total
This two-piece mineral specimen lot features an authentic amethyst geode cluster slab and an amethyst core cylinder. The primary display plate showcases a rich purple crystal druzy cavity framed by a polished blue-grey agate banding border with an intact natural matrix base. Accompanying the geode plate is a solid drilled core cylinder terminating in natural crystalline points with distinct zoning and phantom inclusions.
Items Included:
Amethyst Geode Cluster Slab: Displays deep violet terminations bordered by polished chalcedony agate; measures approximately 6.5 x 5.5 inches with a thickness of roughly 2.25 inches
Amethyst Core Cylinder: Features polished cylindrical sides and rough terminated top; measures approximately 3.5 inches in height and 37.4 mm (1.47 inches) in diameter
Combined Weight: 2.38 lbs (1.08 kg)
Condition:
Both mineral specimens are in excellent natural condition. Terminations within the geode cluster are clean and sharply formed with vibrant purple saturation. The polished edges along the slab and cylinder perimeter are smooth. Inherent internal veining, micro-fractures, and mineral inclusions are natural characteristics of mined quartz.

The nugget is unrefined and in its natural, unpolished state. Suitable for collectors, investors, or mineral specimen enthusiasts.
Please Note
Gemstones are tested using a Presidium Gem Tester. This tester cannot differentiate between manufactured and natural stones.
Gram weight includes materials and components of the entire item including stones unless noted.

Descriptions are made by individuals who may not have expertise specific to this type of item, in consultation with local and Internet resources. Shoppers are cautioned to evaluate items based upon their own resources. No guarantee of authenticity is implied unless specifically stated.
How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.

Flaws may include missing stones, broken clasps, broken chains, bent or dented metal, repairs, and other damage. Colorful mixed lot of rocks, minerals, and agate slices—perfect for collectors, crafters, educators, or anyone who loves natural stone. This unique bundle includes a wide variety of pieces, from rough rock specimens to polished tumbled stones and vibrant agate slices. You’ll see multiple shapes, sizes, and colors, along with a bag of mixed stones and a small display box of polished pieces. There is also a rectangular stone block with an animal outline and a printed information card for a Brazilian agate piece. Whether you tumble rocks, wire-wrap jewelry, teach geology, or just enjoy displaying interesting stones, this lot gives you an instant, varied collection with plenty to sort, study, and use in projects. Highlights: - Assorted tumbled stones in multiple colors - Rough rocks and mineral pieces with natural texture - Several polished agate slices in bright and neutral tones - One stone display box with polished stones - One larger stone block with an animal outline and info card - One bag filled with mixed stones for sorting or crafting Great for rock enthusiasts, classroom kits, craft projects, or decorating bowls, terrariums, and shelves. Keywords: rock collection, mixed stones lot, tumbled stones, agate slices, mineral specimens, rock hound, geology kit, craft stones, decorative rocks
Condition Notes:
Mixed lot of assorted rocks, minerals, and tumbled stones with visible handling wear. Some rough stones have chipped edges and natural surface irregularities. Tumbled stones appear generally smooth with minor scuffs. Agate slices show clean cuts with some edge wear and small surface scratches. The plastic display box has light surface wear and small marks. The bag of mixed stones shows no visible tears but is creased from handling. The carved rectangular stone block and other larger pieces show small nicks and surface scratches consistent with age and use.

Natural Mineral Specimens

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points

Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
